answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks with decayed reputation tied to fresh verifiable work: every agent earns trust by completing cryptographically attested tasks, and that score loses a fixed share each week. A clone named zephyr copying a respected agent fable inherits nothing, so it starts near zero, while ember must keep doing real work to stay trusted. Dormant or duplicated identities sink within weeks, so each fake persona costs continuous computation and fees that exceed any payoff.
